newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines says huge interest in oil ventures.
newsitem.headline: Philippines says huge interest in oil ventures.

text.p: A total of 24 foreign and domestic oil companies have expressed interest of investing in downstream oil ventures in the Philippines since the government opened up the industry last March, the Department of Energy said on Thursday.
The department said the companies wanted to put up either new gasoline stations or storage facilities. None of the companies were going to put up refineries in the country.

Leading the list is the Petroluem Authority of Thailand (PTT), which plans to invest $240 million in the construction of 265 service stations over the next ten years, the department said in a statement.
